message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine crimes based on facts: The defendant Liu Xx, during investigation of alleged embezzlement, colluded with others to fabricate false facts, instructed a witness to change testimony (false testimony), and gave false statements to investigating authorities. This constitutes "伪证罪" (giving false testimony) and "妨害司法罪" maybe "妨害司法公正罪" (obstructing justice). Under Chinese Criminal Law, article 307: "伪证罪" for giving false testimony, false statements to judicial organs. Also article 308: "徇私舞弊罪" (perverting the course of justice) for judges, prosecutors, etc. But for laypersons, article 307 also covers "向司法机关提供虚假证据". So the acts: (1) instructing witness to give false testimony = "伪证罪". (2) making false statements to investigation = also "伪证罪" (since false statements to investigative organs). Could also be "妨害司法罪" (obstructing justice) under article 307? Actually article 307: "伪证罪" includes giving false statements to judicial organs, and also "提供虚假证据". So both actions fall under same crime. However sometimes they charge "妨害司法罪" (obstructing justice) under article 277? Actually article 277 is "徇私舞弊罪" for judges, prosecutors. For laypersons, article 307 is appropriate.

Thus likely the charge is "伪证罪". Also possibly "妨害国家机关侦查罪" (obstructing investigation) under article 306? Article 306: "妨害国家机关侦查、审判、执行的行为" includes giving false statements? Actually article 306: "妨害国家机关执行职务罪" includes obstruction. But typical charge for giving false statements to police is "妨害司法公正罪"? In practice, they charge "伪证罪" and "妨害司法公正罪". The text says "妨害国家司法机关正常的诉讼活动和他人作证的权利" which aligns with "妨害司法公正罪". So we can list two: 伪证罪;妨害司法公正罪.

Thus answer: [罪名]伪证罪;妨害司法公正罪<eoa>
